summary: Willy tells the festival that the island is the world's enemy. Reiner understands too late. Eren is already under the stage.

segments.ja: 収容区の広場は、世界の客で埋まっています。埋まっている席の正面に、ヴィリーの舞台があります。ある舞台を、ガビはエルディアの晴れ舞台だと思っています。思っている列に、ウドとゾフィアとファルコがいます。いるファルコの顔は、まだ白いです。白い理由を、彼は今夜は繰り返しません。繰り返さない隣で、軍の銃が客の外側を囲んでいます。囲む配置は、祝祭の飾りに見えます。
segments.en: The square of the internment zone is filled with the world's guests. In front of the filled seats is Willy's stage. Gabi thinks the stage that is there is Eldia's proud day. In the row that thinks so are Udo, Zofia, and Falco. Falco's face, which is there, is still white. He does not repeat tonight the reason it is white. Beside the not repeating, the army's guns surround the outside of the guests. The posting that surrounds them looks like a decoration of the festival.

segments.titleJa: ヴィリーは歴史を話す
segments.ja: ヴィリーは、古い帝国の話から始めます。始める話は、エルディアがかつて世界を踏み、その残りが島の壁だ、です。だ、を、彼は謝罪の形で語ります。語る謝罪は、タイバーが内側から帝国を止めてきた、という家の物語です。物語の客は、自分の国の被害をその話に重ねます。重ねる拍手は、まだ戦争ではありません。ではありません。戦争の前の、同意です。同意を、ガビは自分たちの無罪として聞きます。
segments.en: Willy begins from the story of the old empire. The story he begins is that Eldia once trampled the world, and what remains of that is the walls of the island. He tells that claim in the shape of an apology. The apology he tells is the family's story that the Tyburs stopped the empire from the inside. The guests lay the harm of their own countries over that story. The applause of the laying is not yet a war. It is not. It is agreement, before a war. Gabi hears the agreement as their own innocence.

segments.titleJa: ライナーは聞いている
segments.ja: ライナーは、客席の端で同じ話を聞いています。聞いている体は、部屋でエレンを見たあとです。あとでも、彼は舞台へ飛び上がれません。飛び上がれない理由は、飛び上がれば収容区が先に壊れる、です。壊れる想像を、彼はヴィリーの言葉と同時に持ちます。持つ汗が、戦士の制服を冷やします。冷やすあいだ、演説は島の力を一つの脅威へまとめます。まとめる相手は、始祖の力を持つ者です。
segments.en: Reiner is listening to the same story at the edge of the seats. The body that is listening is after seeing Eren in the room. Even after that, he cannot jump up onto the stage. The reason he cannot jump up is that if he jumps, the internment zone breaks first. He holds the imagination of breaking at the same time as Willy's words. The sweat he holds cools the warrior's uniform. While it cools, the speech gathers the island's power into one threat. The opponent it gathers is the one who holds the Founding power.

segments.titleEn: He calls the island the enemy
segments.ja: ヴィリーは、島に残る力を、世界全体の敵として名指しします。名指しする瞬間、祭りの空気が軍の空気に変わります。変わる音は、拍手ではなく、席が鳴る音です。鳴る席で、外交の客は自国の旗のように顔を上げます。上げる顔を、マガトは成功として見ます。見る成功は、マーレが単独ではなく、世界の先頭に立つ、です。立つ位置を、ヴィリーは自分の命で買うつもりです。つもりを、客はまだ知りません。
segments.en: Willy names the power remaining on the island as the enemy of the whole world. In the moment of naming it, the air of the festival changes into the air of an army. The sound of the change is not applause. It is the sound of seats. In the seats that sound, the diplomatic guests lift their faces like their own countries' flags. Magath sees the faces they lift as success. The success he sees is that Marley stands at the front of the world, not alone. Willy intends to buy the position of standing with his own life. The guests do not yet know the intention.

segments.en: Gabi receives the naming as a cleansing of Eldia. The idea she receives is to separate the bad island and the good themselves. segments.ja: ピークは、演説のあいだも舞台の下を気にしています。気にしている通路に、昨日の足跡の続きがあります。ある続きが、今は人の熱になっています。なっている場所は、ヴィリーの足の真下です。真下にいるのが誰か、彼女はまだ断言しません。断言しないまま、ポルコに目だけで知らせます。知らせを受けた顎の担い手は、客席を割れずに動けません。動けない広場が、演説の檻です。
segments.en: Even during the speech, Pieck is minding the space under the stage. In the passage she is minding, there is a continuation of yesterday's footprints. The continuation that is there has now become a person's heat. The place it has become is directly under Willy's feet. She does not yet declare who is directly under. Without declaring, she signals Porco with her eyes alone. The holder of the Jaw, receiving the signal, cannot move without splitting the seats. The square that cannot move is the cage of the speech.

segments.en: When the enemy's name is fixed as the island, Reiner finally raises his body. The direction he raises it toward is under the stage. The distance of running under is as far as the rows of seats. While it is far, Willy advances the talk toward a declaration of fighting. The words he advances are a political sentence: from here we fight the island. The world's guests accept the sentence. The applause of accepting makes Reiner's feet slower still. The guilt that slows them is that he did not stop it in the room yesterday.

segments.titleEn: Falco is in the front row
segments.ja: ファルコは、ガビに誘われた前列にいます。いる位置は、舞台の熱が直接顔に来る位置です。来る熱の中で、彼はクルーガーの静かな目を思い出します。思い出す目が、この演説のどこかにいる気がします。気がするだけで、彼は立てません。立てない理由は、ガビの手が彼の膝の上にある、です。ある手を、彼は払いません。払わないことが、まだ友人でいる最後です。
segments.en: Falco is in the front row Gabi invited him to. The position he is in is a position where the heat of the stage comes directly onto the face. Inside the heat that comes, he remembers Kruger's quiet eyes. He has a feeling the eyes he remembers are somewhere in this speech. With only the feeling, he cannot stand. The reason he cannot stand is that Gabi's hand is on his knee. He does not brush away the hand that is there. Not brushing it away is the last of still being a friend.

segments.ja: マガトは、演説が頂点に達する前に、銃の班へ合図を出しています。出している合図は、舞台を守れ、ではなく、客のパニックを切れ、です。切れ、の意味は、住民と外交官を分ける、です。分ける準備が、祝祭の裏の戦争です。戦争を、ヴィリーは自分の死も含めて設計しています。設計を、マガトは実行の側で受けています。受けている顔は、子供の候補を見ていません。見ていない広場の端に、ガビがいます。
segments.en: Before the speech reaches its peak, Magath has already signaled the gun squads. The signal he has sent is not protect the stage. It is cut the guests' panic. The meaning of cut is to separate residents and diplomats. The preparation of separating is the war behind the festival. Willy has designed the war including his own death. Magath receives the design on the side that carries it out. The face that receives it is not looking at the child candidates. Gabi is at the edge of the square he is not looking at.

Inside the heat that comes, he remembers Kruger's quiet eyes. He has a feeling the eyes he remembers are somewhere in this speech. With only the feeling, he cannot stand. The reason he cannot stand is that Gabi's hand is on his knee. He does not brush away the hand that is there. Not brushing it away is the last of still being a friend.

vocab.exampleJa: 持つ汗が、戦士の制服を冷やします。
vocab.exampleEn: Reiner is listening to the same story at the edge of the seats. The body that is listening is after seeing Eren in the room. Even after that, he cannot jump up onto the stage. The reason he cannot jump up is that if he jumps, the internment zone breaks first. He holds the imagination of breaking at the same time as Willy's words. The sweat he holds cools the warrior's uniform. While it cools, the speech gathers the island's power into one threat. The opponent it gathers is the one who holds the Founding power.
